eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue

additional_info.subject: RE: 0470407 - ID0470407-DC/Si-D/DE- [Y2/T04002925646] Depofinity Issue CRM:00314000251
additional_info.body:
Hello Domenico,
Thank you for sending me the documentation on DepotFinity. I aligned internally, and found out that for issues with DepotFinity it is necessary to open a Jira ticket to the respective Team dealing with DepotFinity, as we from service have no access as well.
The ticket can be created from your side as well. Here is the link:
https://si-emobility.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/34/group/209/create/221
You have to select as Product "DepotFinity", and complete the other fields. That's the way forward according to our current process. This enables Regions to be independent on reporting issues on DepotFinity and receive support from the appropriate Team.
I will send you back this ticket to your queue. If you need further support, or need to speed up the resolution once the ticket is create, do not hesitate to contact me and I will support you to escalate the issue.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
